ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to Finance, Actuarial Science, 1st Stage Accountancy majors. Dual degree students who are declared Accountancy will NOT receive registration priority. On April 22 at approximately noon, any remaining seats will open to other College of Business students. On April 29, all sections will be closed and seat limits will be set below the number of registered students. Registered students who drop the course can request to reregister for the dropped section, space permitting. Prerequisite (FIN 221) will be enforced. Students who have not completed FIN 221 will be removed from FIN 300.
